title: Replication package: Would the Score Have Warned Us? A Point-in-Time Validity Audit of Open-Source Health and Security Scores
description:
Code and derived data for the paper. Raw source data are not redistributed.

Version 1.1.0 adds the dating of the commits read by the published Scorecard scan of 2024-07-29, with a comparison without the projects whose scanned commit is from after the freeze date; macros for the span of the CrOSSD record and a word count for the manuscript; table layouts for a one-column manuscript. No number published in version 1.0.0 changes.
